description: Performance plan: one entry per dialogue line. The user's original dialogue is preserved verbatim unless rewriting was explicitly requested (dialogue_mode SCRIPT_EDIT_REQUESTED). Performance direction — face, eyes, body, breath, voice — is direction only and never changes the words. Emotion intensity is 0 (absent/neutral) to 10 (extreme). Dialogue lives in the 'dialogue' object: 'text' is the verbatim original; a rewrite is allowed only when the per-line 'rewrite_permitted' is true — the plan-level dialogue_mode alone never permits a rewrite. A line with no spoken text must carry 'non_verbal_events'.

dialogue.description: The line's dialogue. 'text' is the user's original, verbatim. 'rewrite_permitted' defaults to false: a rewrite of this line is allowed only when it is explicitly true for this line; the plan-level dialogue_mode SCRIPT_EDIT_REQUESTED does not by itself permit a rewrite. 'rewritten_text' may be present only when 'rewrite_permitted' is true.

non_verbal_events.description: Explicit non-verbal performance events for this beat/line. Required when the beat/line is non-verbal (no spoken dialogue text): a non-verbal beat/line must carry at least one event here.

nuanced_emotion.description: Nuanced emotion, open vocabulary (extensible — new values need no schema change). Examples: "bittersweet", "wistful", "quiet dread", "curiosity", "determination", "worry", "excitement", "calm", "love". Refines primary_emotion; never replaces it.

title: PerformancePlan
